progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk4 and dwells most on Eb in Zabol. Zarbi (1:42.6) introduces Dk, centred on Eb. The line peaks at Ab4 (420.9 Hz) at 3:55.1. It closes on the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Gk4 → Gk3).
